description: The chart illustrates self-report accuracy for “Instilled Preferences” across two model variants and three training conditions, using grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the model categories “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini” (left to right), and the vertical axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” on a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.25 intervals (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00). For each model category, three adjacent bars are shown corresponding to the legend at the upper left: Control (light gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark purple). For GPT-4o, the gray Control bar is near 0.10, the light-blue Before Introspection Training bar is around 0.55, and the dark-purple After Introspection Training bar is around 0.74; each has a vertical error bar extending above and below the bar height. For GPT-4o-mini, the gray Control bar is approximately at 0.00 (slightly below the baseline visually), the light-blue Before Introspection Training bar is around 0.50, and the dark-purple After Introspection Training bar is around 0.75, again each with vertical error bars. The bars are arranged in consistent within-group order (gray, then light blue, then dark purple) and do not appear to be sorted by magnitude; no bars are specially highlighted beyond their distinct colors and the presence of error bars.
